reproduction_manifest.notes: PISD Poisson inverse problem (500 obs on u, hyperbolic_44) successfully reproduced on 100 test samples. Rel. err(a)=18.78±4.22% vs paper 13.81±3.11% (within ~1.2σ, slightly higher). PDE residual (finite-difference) matches paper: 0.446 vs 0.45 target. Fourier-space PDE residual: 0.0365. Pre-trained model 'pretrained-poisson_hyperbolic_44-fourier.pkl' used directly. Test dataset from DiffusionPDE (testing.zip). Code patch applied to handle zero observations of coefficient a (obs_a=0). Guidance coefficients: λu=20, λa=0, λPDE=0.00005. Frequency-aware Adam optimizer: β1=0.985, β2=0.98, lr_low=0.2, lr_high=0.01.
reproduction_manifest.eval_output_format: stdout: 'RESULTS: Rel.err(a)=MEAN±STD%, PDE res.=MEAN, PDE res.(FD)=MEAN'. Full stats in eval_results_100.json.
reproduction_manifest.known_levers: Guidance weights (λu, λPDE) can trade off Rel. err vs PDE residual (Table 14 in paper shows Rel. err varies 11-19% across λu=[1,10000]). Frequency-aware Adam hyperparameters (β1, β2, lr_low, lr_high) affect convergence. Truncation strategy (hyperbolic vs square, 32/44/64 modes) changes accuracy/cost trade-off. Number of diffusion steps (currently 2000). Observation count and type (u, a, or both).
reproduction_manifest.setup_notes: Container: pytorch/pytorch:2.1.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime with Python 3.10. Added packages: einops, gdown. Test dataset downloaded from Google Drive (DiffusionPDE testing.zip, 7.8GB) into /autosota_cache/tmp, extracted poisson.mat to /repo/data/test/poisson/. Patched generate_poisson_f.py to handle obs_a=0 (division by zero fix). Pre-trained model from repo's trained_models/ directory. pip cache: /autosota_cache/pip. Hugging Face not used.

optimization_objective.summary: Minimize relative L2 error on reconstructed coefficient a for the Poisson inverse problem (500 sparse observations on solution u, 128×128 grid, hyperbolic_44 spectral truncation). PDE residual is a coupled guardrail that should remain low (current 0.446, paper target 0.45).

metrics.name: Rel. err
metrics.rationale: Primary paper metric: relative L2 error of reconstructed coefficient a. Paper reports 13.81% with CI [10.70%, 16.92%]. Lower values indicate better PDE parameter reconstruction from sparse solution observations.

metrics.name: PDE res.
metrics.rationale: Coupled guardrail metric: finite-difference PDE residual measures how well the reconstructed fields satisfy the Poisson equation. Paper reports 0.45. Should not degrade significantly while improving Rel. err. Fourier-space residual (L_pde=0.0365) is much lower due to spectral derivative accuracy.

optimization_objective.success_policy: Primary goal: reduce Rel. err toward paper's 13.81% (or below). PDE residual should stay below ~0.67 (50% regression tolerance from 0.446). If both metrics improve simultaneously, that is ideal. If Rel. err improves but PDE residual degrades moderately, improvement is still valuable. If PDE residual degrades severely (>2x baseline), treat as failure.
